items.title: Michael Weiss interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 22, 2021
items.q: playing at Small’s, a quartet with Steve Wilson

ctx.x: This has been a wonderful conversation and I want to wrap up with something I heard last night of you playing at Small’s, a quartet with Steve Wilson. And I think you were playing a song called “Atlantis.” And I heard, I think, this little motif and I’ll try to hum it [scats]. And it came up every once in a while and it struck me like this is your way — forgive me if I’m making too much out of this, but it sounded like you were doing this with the idea of sort of marking a part in this performance and keeping the…

Well it’s just the pick-up bar of the melody. It’s the opening line of the song. It’s not the — it’s just the pick-up line into the melody, it’s not the melody per se, it’s just the opening into the melody. But let’s see, I think the way the form of the piece goes there was a little vamp section, there was the song form which was an open number of choruses for each soloist.
